mapper.select: /* LeaveRemnantCoverMapper.selectRemnantPolicy */ SELECT UP.ALLOW_REMNANT_ROUND_UP AS allowRemnantRoundUp , UP.USAGE_UNIT AS usageUnit FROM TB_LEAVE_POLICY P JOIN TB_LEAVE_USAGE_POLICY UP ON UP.POLICY_SEQ = P.POLICY_SEQ WHERE P.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND P.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY P.POLICY_SEQ DESC LIMIT 1
/* LeaveRemnantCoverMapper.selectNextLeaveId */ SELECT CONCAT('LV', DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d'), FNC_CMM_SEQ_NEXTVAL(#{cmpnyCd}, 'LEAVE_USE_ID')) FROM DUAL
/* LeaveRemnantCoverMapper.selectNextCoverId */ SELECT CONCAT('RC', DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d'), FNC_CMM_SEQ_NEXTVAL(#{cmpnyCd}, 'LEAVE_REMNANT_COVER')) FROM DUAL

/* LeaveRemnantCoverMapper.selectActiveCovers */ SELECT C.COVER_ID AS coverId , C.REQ_ID AS reqId , C.SITE_CD AS siteCd , C.WORK_YMD AS workYmd , C.USE_UNIT_TYPE AS useUnitType , C.CHARGE_DAYS AS chargeDays , C.REMNANT_DAYS AS remnantDays , C.COVER_DAYS AS coverDays , C.COVER_MINUTES AS coverMinutes , C.CONV_MINUTES AS convMinutes FROM TB_LEAVE_REMNANT_COVER C WHERE C.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND C.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND C.COVER_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND C.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY C.WORK_YMD ASC, C.COVER_ID ASC FOR UPDATE

/* LeaveRemnantCoverMapper.selectCoverSummaryRows */ SELECT C.COVER_ID AS coverId , C.USER_CD AS userCd , U.USER_NM AS userNm , C.WORK_YMD AS workYmd , C.USE_UNIT_TYPE AS useUnitType , C.CHARGE_DAYS AS chargeDays , C.REMNANT_DAYS AS remnantDays , C.COVER_DAYS AS coverDays , C.COVER_MINUTES AS coverMinutes , C.CONV_MINUTES AS convMinutes , C.COVER_STATUS AS coverStatus , C.REQ_ID AS reqId , DATE_FORMAT(C.INSERT_DATE, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS insertDate FROM TB_LEAVE_REMNANT_COVER C LEFT JOIN TB_USER U ON U.CMPNY_CD = C.CMPNY_CD AND U.USER_CD = C.USER_CD WHERE C.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND C.DEL_YN = 'N' AND C.COVER_DAYS > 0
AND C.COVER_STATUS != 'CANCELLED' AND C.WORK_YMD LIKE CONCAT(#{year}, '%') ORDER BY C.WORK_YMD DESC, C.COVER_ID DESC LIMIT 500

/* LeaveRemnantCoverMapper.selectRemnantRemainByUser */ SELECT U.USER_CD AS userCd , U.USER_NM AS userNm , SUM(G.GRANT_DAYS - G.USED_DAYS) AS remnantDays , MIN(G.AVAIL_TO_DATE) AS nearestExpireYmd FROM TB_USER U JOIN TB_USER_LEAVE_GRANT G ON G.CMPNY_CD = U.CMPNY_CD AND G.USER_CD = U.USER_CD WHERE U.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND U.USE_YN = 'Y' AND U.WITHDRAWAL_DATE IS NULL AND U.ACCOUNT_STATUS = '01' AND G.DEL_YN = 'N' AND G.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND G.AVAIL_FROM_DATE <= #{todayYmd} AND G.AVAIL_TO_DATE >= #{todayYmd} AND (G.GRANT_DAYS - G.USED_DAYS) > 0 AND G.LEAVE_CD IN #{cd} GROUP BY U.USER_CD, U.USER_NM HAVING SUM(G.GRANT_DAYS - G.USED_DAYS) > 0 ORDER BY MIN(G.AVAIL_TO_DATE) ASC, U.USER_CD ASC LIMIT 500
